group_protected_translated_text: 背景：血管源性认知障碍的演变正日益成为突出的健康威胁，尤其是在高血压已成为全球疾病负担和健康损失首要贡献者的时代。高血压与脑微循环改变及不良血管重塑相关，进而导致精神处理速度减慢、抽象推理能力下降、语言能力丧失以及注意力和记忆缺陷。鉴于坦桑尼亚高血压负担迅速上升，我们旨在评估在坦桑尼亚一家三级心血管医院就诊的高血压患者中认知障碍的患病率及相关因素。方法：2020年3月至2021年2月期间，在达累斯萨拉姆的一家三级公立教学医院——Jakaya Kikwete心脏研究所（JKCI）开展了一项基于医院的横断面研究。采用连续抽样法招募在预约门诊就诊时签署知情同意书的高血压门诊患者。使用全科医生认知评估量表（GPCOG）评分评估认知功能。所有统计分析均采用STATA v11.0软件进行。Pearson卡方检验和Student's t检验分别用于比较分类变量和连续变量。采用Logistic回归分析评估与认知障碍相关的因素。报告比值比（OR）、95%置信区间（CI）和 $p$ 值。所有检验均为双侧检验，以 $p < 0.05$ 表示具有统计学显著性。结果：本研究共纳入1201例高血压患者。平均年龄为58.1岁，女性约占研究人群的近三分之二。约四分之三的患者体重超标，16.6%患有糖尿病，7.7%有卒中病史，5.7%患有心力衰竭，16.7%存在肾功能不全，53.7%患有贫血，27.7%存在高甘油三酯血症，38.5%低密度脂蛋白（LDL）升高，2.4%感染HIV。近三分之二的参与者血压控制不佳，8.7%存在体位性低血压。总体而言，524例（43.6%）参与者存在认知障碍。在包含16项特征的Logistic回归模型的双变量分析中，14个参数显示与认知功能相关。然而，在校正混杂因素后，多变量分析显示小学及以下学历（OR 3.5, 95%CI 2.4–5.2, $p < 0.001$）、失业状态（OR 1.7, 95%CI 1.2–2.6, $p < 0.01$）、农村居住（OR

members.protected_source_text: Background: The evolution of cognitive impairment of vascular origin is increasingly becoming a prominent health threat particularly in this era where hypertension is the leading contributor of global disease burden and overall health loss. Hypertension is associated with the alteration of the cerebral microcirculation coupled by unfavorable vascular remodeling with consequential slowing of mental processing speed, reduced abstract reasoning, loss of linguistic abilities, and attention and memory deficits. Owing to the rapidly rising burden of hypertension in Tanzania, we sought to assess the prevalence and correlates of cognitive impairment among hypertensive patients attending a tertiary cardiovascular hospital in Tanzania.

members.protected_source_text: Methodology: A hospital-based cross-sectional study was conducted at Jakaya Kikwete Cardiac Institute, a tertiary care public teaching hospital in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania between March 2020 and February 2021. A consecutive sampling method was utilized to recruit consented hypertensive outpatients during their scheduled clinic visit. General Practitioner Assessment of Cognition (GPCOG) Score was utilized in the assessment of cognitive functions. All statistical analyses utilized STATA v11.0 software. Pearson Chi square and Student's T-test were used to compare categorical and continuous variables respectively. Logistic regression analyses were used to assess for factors associated with cognitive impairment. Odd ratios with 95% confidence intervals and p-values are reported. All tests were 2-sided and p < 0.05 was used to denote a statistical significance.

members.protected_source_text: Results: A total of 1201 hypertensive patients were enrolled in this study. The mean age was 58.1 years and females constituted nearly two-thirds of the study population. About three quarters had excess body weight, 16.6% had diabetes, 7.7% had history of stroke, 5.7% had heart failure, 16.7% had renal dysfunction, 53.7% had anemia, 27.7% had hypertriglyceridemia, 38.5% had elevated LDL, and 2.4% were HIV-infected. Nearly two-thirds of participants had uncontrolled blood pressure and 8.7% had orthostatic hypotension. Overall, 524 (43.6%) of participants had cognitive impairment.
